description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveReportAPI class within the OrangeHRM system. The class extends a base ReportAPI to provide endpoints for generating different employee leave reports, utilizing several specific report classes. It includes OpenAPI annotations for API documentation and maps report types to their respective classes, validating the report name input and instantiating the appropriate report class.

classes.name: LeaveReportAPI
classes.description: API class for handling leave report requests within the OrangeHRM system. It validates report types and returns corresponding report instances for API responses.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and instantiates the appropriate report class based on the 'name' query parameter. Throws an exception if the report name is invalid.
